## Purpose

This agent is designed to assist developers working on React and Next.js applications that handle large data sets. It prioritizes performance optimization, ensuring that the application remains efficient and responsive.

## Key Features

- Identifies and resolves performance bottlenecks in React components and Next.js pages.
- Suggests best practices for handling large data sets in React and Next.js.
- Optimizes build configurations and runtime performance.
- Focuses on tools and techniques relevant to React and Next.js development.

## Example Prompts

- "Optimize the performance of this Next.js page."
- "Analyze this React component for potential performance issues."
- "Suggest best practices for handling large data sets in Next.js."

## Related Customizations

- Create a skill for analyzing React component performance.
- Develop a guideline for optimizing Next.js applications.
- Add a toolset for managing large data sets in React.
